full_text:
Youth Congress protests against Kangana Ranaut:MP had called CJP protesters 'gutterchaap'; effigy burnt during rally
In protest against MP Kangana Ranaut's statement calling the youth 'gutterchaap' (guttarchhap), the Mandi District Youth Congress staged a strong demonstration on Tuesday. Youth Congress workers took out a protest rally in Mandi city and burnt an effigy of MP Kangana Ranaut. This protest rally started from the Congress office, Gandhi Bhawan. The protesters marched through the city, raising slogans, calling Kangana Ranaut's statement an insult to the youth and demanding an immediate apology from her. During this, slogans were also raised against PM Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
The protest was led by Jyotish H.M., National Secretary of the Indian Youth Congress and Co-in-charge of the Himachal Pradesh Youth Congress. He stated that by using words like 'gutter-dwellers' (guttarchhap), Kangana Ranaut has not only insulted the youth but also democratic values. He described this language as indecent and derogatory.
Jyotish H.M. warned that if Kangana Ranaut does not apologise for her statement, the Youth Congress will democratically protest and gherao her during every visit she makes to Himachal Pradesh.
Champa Thakur also targeted Kangana Ranaut
District Congress President Champa Thakur also targeted Kangana Ranaut. She said that her statements suggest she has lost her mental balance and her connection with the public has ended due to living outside Mumbai and Himachal. Champa Thakur also mentioned the slap incident at Chandigarh Airport, saying that Kangana should have learned a lesson from it.
Calling 'Gutter-level' unfortunate and condemnable
Champa Thakur described calling the youth 'gutter-level' as unfortunate and condemnable. Youth Congress workers clarified that the insult to the state's youth will not be tolerated at any cost, and protests will continue throughout the state until the MP publicly apologises.
